name: ahde
description: Agent Harness Development Environment — build, run, trace, eval, improve project-specific agents

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='dist/cli.js'; const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!s.startsWith('#!')) fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+s)" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && vitest run
scripts.check:quick: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && vitest run --project quick
scripts.acceptance:pilot: npm run build && vitest run tests/vertical-slice.test.ts tests/builder-pi-closed-loop.test.ts tests/improvement-author.test.ts tests/target-tools.test.ts tests/world-run.test.ts tests/rag-xray.test.ts tests/failure-intake.test.ts tests/workbench-production-failure.test.ts tests/rag-xray-surfaces.test.ts tests/executive-version-card.test.ts tests/passport-presentation.test.ts
scripts.acceptance:guided: vitest run tests/builder-conversation-lifecycle.test.ts tests/builder-jobs.test.ts tests/builder-pi-natural-language.test.ts tests/builder-pi-closed-loop.test.ts tests/builder-pi-workshop-loop.test.ts tests/workbench-composites.test.ts tests/evidence-comparison.test.ts
scripts.vendor:build: cd vendor/pi-mono && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run hydrate:model-data && npm run build:offline
scripts.vendor:pack: cd vendor/pi-mono/packages/telemetry && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../ai && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../agent && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../protocol && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../client && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../tui && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../coding-agent && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs
